Get the normalized count table

Source: R/generics.R, R/screenr-class.R
get_normalized_count_table.Rd

Returns the normalized count table of a ScreenR object, computed with normalize_data. A short summary of the size of the table is printed.

Usage

get_normalized_count_table(object)

# S4 method for class 'screenr_object'
get_normalized_count_table(object)

Arguments

object

The ScreenR object obtained using create_screenr_object.

Value

A tibble with the Barcode column and one column of normalized counts for each sample (an empty tibble if the data have not been normalized).

See also

normalize_data, set_normalized_count_table, get_count_table

Examples

object <- get0("object", envir = asNamespace("ScreenR"))
normalized_count_table <- get_normalized_count_table(object)
#> ScreenR normalized count table: 5320 rows, 15 columns
